cast.description: The maker's own Foe Booth cast, included on purpose so everyone who plays the house meets them; each photo is a public blob in the maker's repo. Looks only. Absent, players meet their own cast.

look.description: Whose wallpaper, floor and dark it has: the front hall's, upstairs', or the basement's.

name.description: The house's name, 60 characters at most.

rows.description: The floor as rows of tiles, all the same length, 8 to 24 across and 8 to 20 down. `#` wall, `P` wall with a portrait, `W` wall with a window, `.` floor, `S` the start (one), `D` a locked door, `K` the key (at most one), `E` the stairs out (at most one), `A` rounds, `+` a medkit, `g` a ghoul, `h` a hound, `a` a ghoul that waits for the key, `T` the Thing (at most one), `V` the one you came for (at most one). The outside is all walls. A house is won by the stairs (any doors open with the key), or, with `V`, by putting the Thing down (its doors open then) and reaching `V`; everything that matters must be reachable. A reader refuses a house that breaks these.

main.description: A haunted house somebody made in Haunt the Sky's editor and published into their own repo: one floor, its look, its name, and optionally the maker's own cast. Anyone can play it from its link; runs in it name it by a strong ref, so a house rebuilt later never changes a night already played.
